label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Michael Kim’s 59 at 3M Open
items.text: Michael Kim shot a second-round 59 at the 3M Open, birdieing his last four holes for the PGA Tour’s 16th sub-60 round, teeing off Saturday at 1:35 p.m. with Ben Kohles.

items.headline: Top Names Miss 3M Open Cut
items.text: The 3M Open cut fell at 2-under, sending home Tony Finau, Max Homa, Sungjae Im, Nick Dunlap, and Matt Kuchar, while Patton Kizzire withdrew after a 77 opening round.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau’s LIV Growth
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said he is a better, more complete golfer on LIV due to learning different grasses and conditions, drawing large galleries and boosting LIV’s buzz.
